private_literal.literal:
private def actual_integrated_hazard_clock_statement
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : Prop :=
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let H : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun y xRef z =>
      (η⁻¹ * ‖z.1 - c y xRef‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.2‖ ^ 2) / 2
    let C : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun y xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * (β : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * H y xRef z) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * η * H y xRef z) + ‖c y xRef - xRef‖)
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let W : E → E → (E × E) → Measure (WithTop ℝ≥0) := fun y xRef z =>
      Measure.map (fun e : ℝ => τ y xRef z (Real.toNNReal e))
        (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    Continuous (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
      Λ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2) ∧
    Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
      Λ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)) volume 0 (t : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E,
      Λ y xRef z 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ t : ℝ≥0, 0 ≤ Λ y xRef z t) ∧
      Monotone (Λ y xRef z)) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e t : ℝ≥0,
      τ y xRef z e ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ↔ (e : ℝ) ≤ Λ y xRef z t) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e : ℝ≥0,
      (τ y xRef z e = ⊤ ↔ ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Λ y xRef z t < (e : ℝ)) ∧
      (τ y xRef z e ≠ ⊤ → Λ y xRef z (τ y xRef z e).untopA = (e : ℝ)) ∧
      (0 < e → (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef z e) ∧ τ y xRef z 0 = 0) ∧
    Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
      τ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, IsProbabilityMeasure (W y xRef z) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, (W y xRef z).real (Set.Ioi (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)) =
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z t)) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, 0 ≤ C y xRef z ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Λ y xRef z t ≤ C y xRef z * (t : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e : ℝ≥0,
      (0 < C y xRef z →
        (Real.toNNReal ((e : ℝ) / C y xRef z) : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤ τ y xRef z e) ∧
      (C y xRef z = 0 → 0 < e → τ y xRef z e = ⊤))

public_header.literal:
theorem actual_integrated_hazard_clock_laws
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_integrated_hazard_clock_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Joint hazard continuity
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
Continuous (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
      Λ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2)
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: Continuous in ALL(y,xRef,z,t) with t NNReal; a.1.1.1=y,a.1.1.2=xRef,a.1.2=z,a.2=t.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Joint hazard Borel
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
      Λ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2)
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: Measurable same tuple/time. It is a conclusion, no measurable-integrand premise.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Finite-interval integrability
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)) volume 0 (t : ℝ))
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: All original states and every finite nonnegative endpoint; real Lebesgue intervalIntegral integrand actual rate∘flow.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Normalized monotone nonnegative hazard
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E,
      Λ y xRef z 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ t : ℝ≥0, 0 ≤ Λ y xRef z t) ∧
      Monotone (Λ y xRef z))
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: Lambda0=0, every value>=0, Monotone on NNReal. Real codomain is finite at every finite t.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Exact finite-time first-crossing identity
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e t : ℝ≥0,
      τ y xRef z e ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ↔ (e : ℝ) ≤ Λ y xRef z t)
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: tau<=cast t iff e<=Lambda t, all e,t NNReal, including e0/infinity output.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Infinity/attainment/positive/zero branches
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e : ℝ≥0,
      (τ y xRef z e = ⊤ ↔ ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Λ y xRef z t < (e : ℝ)) ∧
      (τ y xRef z e ≠ ⊤ → Λ y xRef z (τ y xRef z e).untopA = (e : ℝ)) ∧
      (0 < e → (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef z e) ∧ τ y xRef z 0 = 0)
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: top iff ALL finite times have Lambda<e; finite tau equality uses guarded untopA; e>0->tau>0; tau0=0.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Joint clock Borel
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
      τ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2)
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: Measurable on right-associated((y,xRef),(z,e)), matching hittingAfter parameter projections exactly; no clock continuity assumption.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Actual one-clock probability and survival
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, IsProbabilityMeasure (W y xRef z) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, (W y xRef z).real (Set.Ioi (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)) =
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z t))
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: IsProbabilityMeasure W plus real measure of strict Ioi(cast t)=exp(-Lambda t); infinity remains in survival tail.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Exact actual cap and integrated bound
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, 0 ≤ C y xRef z ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Λ y xRef z t ≤ C y xRef z * (t : ℝ))
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: C>=0 and Lambda t<=C*t at SAME starting energy H(z), all finite nonnegative times; actual orbit conservation is proof obligation.

ten_top_conjunctions.label: Extended wait lower bound/zero cap
ten_top_conjunctions.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ e : ℝ≥0,
      (0 < C y xRef z →
        (Real.toNNReal ((e : ℝ) / C y xRef z) : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤ τ y xRef z e) ∧
      (C y xRef z = 0 → 0 < e → τ y xRef z e = ⊤))
ten_top_conjunctions.meaning: Positive C is scoped antecedent, not caller; toNNReal ratio equals e/C when C>0. C0 and positive e give top; e0 still0 from clause6.
